meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a site tour (/website-to-video). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本自动生成无脸解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速把文字内容变成视觉化解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn text into visual explainer videos

howto.what: 将任意文字（文章、笔记、主题等）转化为无真人出镜的解说视频。视频画面由 AI 根据场景自动生成（文字排版、抽象图形、图表等），无需录制屏幕或实拍素材。
howto.when: 当你提供一段需要被解释的文字（如概念、教程、清单），并希望生成解说视频时触发。不适用于产品推广或网站导览。

say.text: 帮我用这段文字做一个解说视频，主题是复利。
say.note: 技能会读取文字，生成故事板、脚本和最终视频。

say.text: 把这篇关于光合作用的文章做成一个无真人出镜的科普视频。
say.note: 技能会分析文章结构，设计视觉元素并合成视频。

howto.what_en: Turn any text (article, notes, topic, brief) into a faceless explainer video. Visuals are AI-generated per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz) — no screen capture or real footage needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide text that needs explanation (concept, how-to, listicle) and request a video. Not for product promos or site tours.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into an explainer video.
say_en.note: The skill reads the text, generates storyboard, script, and final video.

say_en.text: Make a faceless explainer video from this photosynthesis text.
say_en.note: The skill analyzes structure, designs visuals, and renders the video.
